import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.1f')

# Plot 2: Quality of Sleep vs Physical Activity
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', s=100, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Physical Activity\n(Color = Stress Level)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Stress Level')

# Plot 3: BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(bmi_counts))
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
        explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts), shadow=True)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# Plot 4: Sleep Disorder by BMI Category
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
disorder_bmi = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Sleep Disorder'])
disorder_bmi.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder by BMI Category')
ax4.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 5: Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
colors_scatter = ['red' if disorder == 'Sleep Apnea' else 'blue' for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder']]
ax5.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], c=colors_scatter, s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps')
# Add legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='blue', label='No Disorder'),
                   Patch(facecolor='red', label='Sleep Apnea')]
ax5.legend(handles=legend_elements)

# Plot 6: Stress Level by Occupation
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
stress_occ = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_stress = sns.color_palette('Reds_r', len(stress_occ))
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(stress_occ)), stress_occ.values, color=colors_stress, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(stress_occ)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(stress_occ.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Stress Level')
ax6.set_title('Stress Level by Occupation')
ax6.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.1f')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
